Sun Dogs Music presents SONGWRITER SHOWCASE 5
This workshop-style songwriters-in-the-round show, hosted by Doug McArthur, featuring the volcanic neo-soul grooves of Shannon Chapman, smoky roots-folk of Amber Rose, intricate pop-folk tapestries of Melody Pearson-Munroe and the witty subversive R&B of Jana Jacobs. These four powerful songwriters share the stage for two sets of three rounds of songs. 
Tuesday, October 6
Doors at 7:00pm
Show at 7:30pm
$10 advance
$15 at the door
